data.exact_reserve_text: Included within the profit is an amount of GBP 26.8 million in respect of releases to reserves on 2012 and prior underwriting years (2013: GBP 10.8 million in respect of reserve releases from 2011 and prior underwriting years, excluding the additional margin discussed above).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,170.467m. The managing agent reports releases to prior year reserves of GBP 26.8m in respect of 2012 and prior underwriting years, driven by benign claims experience (favourable claims development), equivalent to a c.2.3% release of opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within the profit is an amount of GBP 26.8 million in respect of releases to reserves on 2012 and prior underwriting years (2013: GBP 10.8 million in respect of reserve releases from 2011 and prior underwriting years, excluding the additional margin discussed above).
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding prior-year comparative). Prior-year development figure taken from Managing Agent narrative stating GBP 26.8m of 'releases to reserves on 2012 and prior underwriting years'. The report does not present an explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column separate to the overall change, nor a gross claims development triangle; the narrative figure may be net of reinsurance though it is not explicit. Prior-year development therefore used as reported in narrative and flagged as possibly net.
